placements.why: The envelope's content is a technical pipeline-behavior specification (slug derivation, LLM id-gen vs. deterministic fallback, file commit) — an implementation-grain concern. No strata category exists yet in this repo, and nothing supplied approximates this organizational lane, so it is minted standalone as a foundational category rather than forced under a leaf.
placements.title: system-implementation behavior gets its own organizational lane
placements.frame: Does this content describe how the system is built and behaves internally — its mechanisms, fallbacks, and commit guarantees — rather than what to build or why?

placements.title: memory ids are pipeline-derived, not caller-supplied
placements.frame: When a memory arrives without an explicit id, did the pipeline successfully derive a slug from its content — via the LLM id-gen call or the deterministic slugify fallback — and commit the file?
placements.why: src-1 establishes the triggering condition (no explicit id field) and src-2 states the required pipeline behavior in response (produce a slug via LLM id-gen or deterministic fallback, then commit). Together they name a subject future envelopes will keep feeding — e.g. which path fired, whether commit succeeded, edge cases in slugify — not a one-time fact. No existing leaf or strata (both empty for this repo) plausibly holds this theme, so it is minted fresh under the newly-minted Architecture strata.
